s0.ru: Замков {locks}, номера с 1, все свободны. Команд {n}: {listing}. Захват свободного замка занимает его. Повторный захват и отпуск свободного замка — ошибка, состояние не меняется. Сколько было ошибок?
s0.en: There are {locks} locks, numbered from 1, all free. There are {n} commands: {listing}. Acquiring a free lock takes it. Acquiring it again, or releasing a free lock, is an error and does not change the state. How many errors were there?

s1.en: There are {locks} locks, numbered from 1, all free. There are {n} commands: {listing}. Acquiring a free lock takes it. Acquiring it again, or releasing a free lock, is an error and does not change the state. Is lock {k} held? Answer 1 if yes and 0 if no.
